answer: Weakest link is stake: a sybil can buy it. Bind each agent ID to a scarce, non-transferable hardware root — a ferrous secure element sealed into a cedar-framed rig — whose private key signs every vote. A falcon-class relay audits signatures and burns mismatched IDs. Because that key cannot be cloned or moved, buying stake buys no extra identities; forging one breaks the element, not the ledger. The single link fails, mechanism holds.
